narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate for the landing book-map: a Pandoran forest at the moment the sky darkens and the ground answers with its own light, posed so the reversal - the light coming from below, not above - reads at a glance as the puzzle the chapter solves.
subject: A wide Pandoran forest clearing at the instant of the afternoon eclipse. Overhead the banded bulk of a gas giant has swallowed the sun and the sky is deep indigo; below, the forest floor has come alight from underneath - branching root networks tracing cyan paths through the leaf litter, glowing moss cushions, luminous fungal mats at the trunk bases, and veins of light running up the standing leaves. A single spiral-leafed plant is caught half-folded. In the middle distance a large six-legged grazing animal is walking away into cover while, low in the near foreground, the burnished dark shape of a six-legged pack predator steps out of shadow into the lit ground.
scene: A broad clearing among enormous buttressed trunks, the canopy a dark vault overhead, mist pooling low, the lit ground receding into layered forest depth.
camera: A wide, slightly low establishing view that keeps both the darkened sky and the self-lit ground in frame, the two animals small enough to read as figures in a landscape.
light: The scene's only real light comes from the ground upward - cyan and violet bioluminescence throwing soft uplight onto trunk bases and undersides of leaves - with a thin cold rim of planetshine along the upper canopy edges and no warm sunlight anywhere.
palette: Void-indigo sky, deep teal-black forest mass, cyan and faint violet ground glow, one restrained cool amber ember at the predator's eye.
style: Painterly cinematic naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, strong atmospheric depth.
detail_level: Crisp on the glowing root network and the foreground predator; the grazer and mid-forest softer; canopy and sky dissolving into haze.
composition: The dark canopy and eclipsed sky across the upper third, the luminous ground filling the lower two-thirds, the predator lower-left and the departing grazer centre-right, generous dark sky for text, 3:2 landscape.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with the key light coming from the ground, not the sky. Same dark glowing mood as the established chapter covers; reuse the forest-cathedral trunk language from the Part IV plates.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style, no warm sunlight
